gallery.title: File:WWII Survivors Company B 124th Infantry 31st Division.jpg
gallery.credit: Scanned from an original print owned by the family of en:User:Postdlf.
gallery.source: WWII Survivors Company B 124th Infantry 31st Division
gallery.description: World War II combat survivors of Company B, 124th Infantry Regiment, 31st Infantry Division. Photo taken at Camp Stoneman, California, December 1945. Handwritten caption reads "Survivors Co B 124th Inf 31st Div. Activated Apr 5th 1944. First Combat Aitape New Guinea July 1944." The photo developing company's name and address are given in the right corner: "Far East Photo, 300 W. Jefferson, Springfield, Ill."
